notes.title: Ultimate Rumble is the new Mutator in today's patch!
notes.content:
With today's patch we are bringing total mayhem to CARRUMBLE. In order to do so we are adding a new mutator that let's you abuse the use of your special moves! Just join in any game with the Ultimate Rumble mode on and just spam your ultimate but watch out as everyone else will also be spamming!

Are you ready to face this new challenge?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/9e46fd30c59a6f61901f0757edea53184159c1fb.png

Join our community on Discord and don't forget to leave us a review here n Steam!

notes.title: Gus joins the Roster!
notes.content:
A new champion joins today the roster of CARRUMBLE! Gus is the second son of a humble family of Farmers. While working his fields, he tells everyone that he got abducted by an U.F.O. but nobody in town believes him, his face alone is enough to convince everyone that he is just plain mad. From the day he got kidnapped (it's true!) he started participating to the CARRUMBLE tournament, but nobody knows the real reason behind this choice.

[previewyoutube=iZ8SdEwYZYU;full][/previewyoutube]

--------------------------------------
1.05 Patch Notes


 Added Gus, a new Heavy Champion
 Fixed Dojo Map Lightning
 Fixed Golden Liveries layout
 Tuned Localization minor issues In French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Chinese (simplified)

notes.title: CARRUMBLE new Arena: The Dojo Temple
notes.content:
This weeks update is a bit different its not about a new vehicle or game mode but rather a brand new Arena

The Dojo Temple is opening its doors as we speak.

Beware of the traps on the floor and pay attention to not be pushed in the ditch!

[previewyoutube=-1bMvhTUqpA;full][/previewyoutube]


This friday we will also reveal the roadmap for the upcoming months! Are you prepared? What would you like to see in the game? Let us know!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/53d814d70f7659d0729209abd75433fc4d9c290c.png


Patch Notes 1.04:
- Fixed Player’s Diesel earned/used stats.
- Ronin special skins can now be seen in the Liveries menu.
- An invisible nasty tram has been spotted destroying the brawl at its very beginning - it’s been removed.
- Added a new arena: The Dojo Temple
- Fixed Online multiplayer Controller issue.

Have fun, CARRUMBLERS!

notes.title: Local Multiplayer Now Available for free!
notes.content:
We have heard your feedback from the beta and are really really happy to announce Local Multiplayer mode for CARRUMBLE! Four players may now jump into the arena on the same PC and play shoulder to shoulder against each other! Bring your friends to the rumble and have fun! 

Join us on DISCORD and don't forget to leave a review, let us know what you want to see next in CARRUMBLE!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/c3e3b61755e3e59e824cfeedcec97ad9a376b5cf.png

With this new update comes today a new set of patch notes, with some bug fixes and two new golden skins. You can get the new liveries from the garage and those comes for free until the end of December!

PATCH NOTES 1.0.2

 Added moveset list during first brawls
 Added Local Multiplayer
 Visual fixes
 New Sales




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/5f38b4bea139c51b53de687200178e80ae55879e.png

notes.title: Domino joins the roster!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=pzCkINY4Lts;full][/previewyoutube]


A new champion joins today the roster of CARRUMBLE! Domino has been raised in a car depot in the middle of the desert. She doesn't do "girls stuff" and doesn't care what you think. She is a "Mechanic Heavy Metal Player Fighter" and she loves what she does. Her dream is to dominate the CARRUMBLE League, but she doesn't need a reason to. Try her right now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/c02d10f15083f3854b5a0c8b0b27954f887f1ce7.png

This is just the first content that we are going to add in the next months to CARRUMBLE! Expect new vehicles, skins, arena and modes! Feel free to tell us what do you think and what do you want to see in the game!



Patch Notes:

 Domino Joins the roster with Dust Devil and some brand new skins!
 Progression Bar during race rewards has been fixed
 UI Fix for a better support with 21:9 resolution
 Graphic fixes in MultiPark Arena
 You can't skip anymore the race rewards page, so everyone should have now enough time to check their stats at the end of a match
 Fixed Ultimate spawn in "Resource Free" mode on Halloween and Crossroad arenas
 Fixed SilverEye animation
 Added a new intro video
 Localisation fixes
 Daily bug fix
 New and better effects for the damaged vehicles textures
 New icon to properly show locked content until level 20
 Added new particles during explosions
 Arenas optimizations
 Mode, arena and mutator are now hidden in the lobby until last ten seconds before match
 Ui improvements inside the text drive mode
 Garage interface improvements

notes.title: JOIN THE CARRUMBLE CLOSED BETA!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/9b016b08c7f15034d48294649e392d523aa96c46.png

3DClouds is delighted to announce the start of the closed beta for the adrenalinic fighting game CARRUMBLE. The CARRUMBLE closed beta phase begins on Steam, Thursday 3rd October, and finishes 7th October. Register for the upcoming beta, play and share your experience and feedback with the developers on Facebook or Discord.

Content available in this beta:

 4 Champions to choose from: Old Rupert and his Betty, Tomo with the massive Ronin, Coral with the fast Blossom and Domino with the fearsome Dust Devil
 3 different arenas to play on: Stadium, Multi-Storey Car Park, Crossroad
 Two different game modes to try
 Each Beta Player will have a special reward at launch!

ENJOY YOUR WEEK-END!
